en:
The only way to stop the hydraulic press
is the "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Force Stop<CLT=cltNORMAL>" button.

An Electrobomb went off in the hangar, which
would've interfered with the safety function...

There'd be no way to stop the hydraulic press
unless someone used the "Force Stop" button.

When you say someone...you mean Kokichi,
right? He was the only one there.

Hm, actually...maybe I pressed it by accident?
I don't really remember...

The press only stopped for like, a sec. You can't 
switch the victim in such a short time, can you?

There's also the question of how the bodies
got switched while the camera was rolling.
That would've clearly been caught on camera.

Ah, I see. It wasn't just the press
that stopped...

If you stop something else at the same
time you stop the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hydraulic press<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, I see it now. That's
how the bodies were switched!

<CLT=cltMIND>If you stopped that, you could
have swapped the bodies easily...
